env.name: X_API_KEY
env.description: X (Twitter) Developer App's own Consumer API Key (sometimes labeled "API Key") — from the app's "Keys and tokens" page in the X Developer Portal.

env.name: X_API_SECRET
env.description: The same app's Consumer API Secret ("API Key Secret"), from the same page.

env.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: An Access Token generated for this app, scoped to the specific X account that should post/like/repost — generate this under the app's own "Keys and tokens" page, with the app's own permissions set to Read and Write first (an app created with Read-only permissions generates a token that can search/read but every posting tool here will fail).

env.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
env.description: The Access Token Secret paired with X_ACCESS_TOKEN, from the same generation step.
